lines.text: Moses says the man who maintains justice and keeps his hand from doing any evil is blessed.
The foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD must not say the LORD will utterly exclude him.
He gives eunuchs who choose what pleases Him a name better than silver and gold.
He will bring foreigners who love His name and keep the Sabbath to His holy mountain and make them joyful.
His house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations, and He will gather still others.
